name: scoping
description: Explicitly define the boundaries of the task by identifying items that are in-scope and out-of-scope.

proceed_when: Agent is unsure about task boundaries
Need to limit the scope of work

constructor.input:
context:
  problem_statement: string # The defined problem
process:
IF NOT problem_statement:
    RETURN {proceed: false, reason: "Problem statement required to define scope"}
RETURN {proceed: true, reason: "Ready to define scope"}

execute.output:
scope_artifact:
  in_scope: list [string] # 3 items
  out_of_scope: list [string] # 3 items
  reasoning: string
process: List 3 distinct items/areas that are critical to solving the problem.
Constraint: Items must be of different nature (e.g., technical, process, documentation).
List 3 distinct items/areas that are explicitly excluded to prevent scope creep.
Constraint: Items must be of different nature.
Ensure logical separation between In-Scope and Out-Of-Scope.
Use 'write_file' tool (if available) or sanitized terminal command to save 'debug/scope_definition.json'.
